project.title: Experiments
project.description: Each experiment is like one sheet of your spreadsheet, with its own columns and sample numbering.

empty.title: No experiments yet
empty.description: Add an experiment, such as a deposition with its own prefix, to start recording samples.

form.title: New experiment
form.description: An experiment has its own columns and numbers its samples from its prefix.
form.codePrefixHint: 2 to 6 letters or digits, starting with a letter, e.g. ALD. Sample codes start with it.
form.protocolHint: Optional. The method every sample in this experiment follows; each sample then only records what differs.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the experiment.
errors.codePrefixInvalid: Use 2 to 6 letters or digits, starting with a letter.
errors.codePrefixDuplicate: Another experiment in this project already uses this prefix.

form.editDescription: Existing sample codes do not change; the prefix only applies to new samples.
